PYTHON PROGRAMMING – IMPORTANT TOPICS & QUESTIONS 
 
  UNIT I – Basics of Python 
  Important Topics 
• 
History & Features of Python 
• 
Tokens & Character Set 
• 
Core Data Types (int, float, str, bool) 
• 
Input/Output functions 
• 
Type conversion 
• 
Operators (Arithmetic, Bitwise, Assignment) 
• 
Operator precedence 
• 
Formatting strings 
• 
Built-in functions 
  Important Questions 
2–5 Marks: 
1. Explain Python tokens. 
2. List Python core data types. 
3. Define operator precedence. 
4. What are compound assignment operators? 
5. Write a program to format numbers and strings. 
10–16 Marks: 
1. Explain Python operators with examples. 
2. Write a program using arithmetic and bitwise operators. 
3. Explain internal working of Python. 
4. Write simple programs using I/O and formatting. 
  Most Important Topics: 
✔ Operators & Expressions 
✔ Core Data Types 
✔ Built-in Functions 
 
  UNIT II – Control Statements & Functions

--- Page Break ---

Important Topics 
• 
Boolean type & relational operators 
• 
Decision statements (if, if-else, nested if) 
• 
Loops (while, for) 
• 
break & continue 
• 
range() function 
• 
Functions 
• 
Parameters & Arguments 
• 
Scope (Local & Global) 
• 
Recursion 
• 
Lambda functions 
  Important Questions 
Short Questions: 
1. Difference between while and for loop. 
2. What is recursion? 
3. Define lambda function. 
4. Explain scope of variables. 
5. What is range() function? 
Long Questions: 
1. Explain decision statements with example. 
2. Write a program using nested loops. 
3. Explain functions with parameters and return statement. 
4. Explain recursion with example program. 
    Very Important: 
✔ Functions & Recursion 
✔ Scope of Variables 
✔ Loop Control Statements 
 
  UNIT III – Strings, Lists, Tuples, Sets, Dictionaries 
  Important Topics 
• 
String operations

--- Page Break ---

• 
String immutability 
• 
List creation & slicing 
• 
List comprehensions 
• 
List methods 
• 
Tuples 
• 
Sets 
• 
Dictionaries 
  Important Questions 
Short Questions: 
1. What is string immutability? 
2. Define list slicing. 
3. What are tuples? 
4. Difference between list and tuple. 
5. Define dictionary. 
Long Questions: 
1. Explain string operations with examples. 
2. Explain list methods and list comprehensions. 
3. Compare List, Tuple, Set, Dictionary. 
4. Write programs using dictionary and set operations. 
    Highly Important: 
✔ List & List Comprehension 
✔ String Operations 
✔ Difference between List, Tuple, Set, Dictionary 
 
  UNIT IV – Exception Handling, File Handling & Modules 
  Important Topics 
• 
Types of Exceptions 
• 
try, except, finally 
• 
File Handling (read, write, append) 
• 
seek() function 
• 
Binary files

--- Page Break ---

• 
Modules & Packages 
• 
Importing modules 
  Important Questions 
Short Questions: 
1. What is exception handling? 
2. Define seek() function. 
3. What is a module? 
4. Difference between text and binary file. 
Long Questions: 
1. Explain Python exception handling with example. 
2. Explain file handling operations. 
3. Explain modules and packages in Python. 
  Most Important: 
✔ Exception Handling 
✔ File Handling 
✔ Modules & Packages 
 
  UNIT V – Object Oriented Programming & Turtle 
  Important Topics 
• 
Class & Object 
• 
Constructor (init) 
• 
Destructor (del) 
• 
Instance & Class variables 
• 
Method overloading 
• 
Operator overloading 
• 
Inheritance 
• 
Encapsulation 
• 
Turtle module 
  Important Questions 
Short Questions: 
1. Define class and object.

--- Page Break ---

2. What is constructor? 
3. What is inheritance? 
4. Define encapsulation. 
5. What is turtle module? 
Long Questions: 
1. Explain OOP concepts in Python. 
2. Write a program using class and constructor. 
3. Explain inheritance with example. 
4. Explain operator overloading. 
5. Write a simple turtle graphics program. 
    Very Important: 
✔ OOP Concepts 
✔ Constructor & Inheritance 
✔ Turtle Graphics Program 
 
  HIGH PRIORITY TOPICS (Study First) 
If exam is near, focus on: 
1. Functions & Recursion 
2. Lists & List Comprehension 
3. File Handling 
4. Exception Handling 
5. OOP Concepts 
6. Inheritance 
7. Decision & Loop Statements
